scope: Provider-neutral user-facing AI/API contracts and a polished, truthful creator workflow. This report covers local validation; production smoke is run separately after deployment.

publicContracts.status: Capability flags, supported task IDs and per-user limits only; no AI vendor/model list or credentials.
publicContracts.generation: Explicit task/requestKey/result plus kind=ai/fallbackUsed/generatedAt. New and cached internal receipts are projected identically.
publicContracts.automation: Managed-consent-only public AI settings; no personal key/model/vendor controls. Stored legacy configurations are not silently changed. Connection summaries, old operational logs/errors and Library receipts are projected.
publicContracts.consentAndSafety: AI processing/usage disclosure, real-AI versus offline distinction, safety refusal stops and separate publishing consent preserved.
publicContracts.dependencyScanException: Third-party Firebase/core-js runtime detection may contain Cloudflare-Workers/CLOUDFLARE platform constants. Those strings do not identify the site’s AI adapter; no AI service endpoint, model ID or integration branding is shipped to normal browser code.

uxVerified: AI Studio keyword clusters, hashtags, readable copy/download reports, 7-day plans with working generator handoffs and editorial review.
Real decoded/resized WebP response downloads in both formats using explicit external HTTP doubles; busy format/tool locks, prompt preservation and stable download filenames.
Live-mode Pin and complete article → private Save → new authenticated browser context → refreshed Cloud Library → full reader, with owner isolation.
All saved Pin titles, keywords, image guidance and neutral AI disclosure remain available in the Library.
Persistent retryable save errors and no silent cloud-to-device fallback; sign-out clears private generated content.
Generated Studio outputs at 320/390/768/1440px and public routes at 320/390/640/768/1024/1440px without horizontal overflow.
Email verification/reset via real local Auth emulator, Google flow boundaries and disabled/revoked identity checks.
Local publishing demo uses honest labels and never claims an external publication.

productionBaseline.indexes: 10 composites + 10 field overrides verified READY in the earlier authorized index-only deployment; not redeployed here.

limitations: External generation/OAuth/publication responses in automated local suites are explicit doubles. Genuine provider consent and live external publication are not claimed.
No authenticated production AI generation/private-save round trip or production email delivery was performed as a real user.
Full Auto native function and Scheduler are undeployed. No paid upgrade, publishing activation or Rules/index changes were authorized by this UI task.
